transcript: Your AI can edit movies now. And not just simple things like captions and cuts, but full production grade edits. DaVinci Resolve, which is a free video editor that's on par with Premiere Pro, just dropped an official MCP server. So you can now connect it directly to Claude Code or Codex and control your entire timeline literally just by having a conversation. So with this, you can now automatically color grade your footage, build motion graphics, create multicam cuts, add sound effects, and even adjust your own music so it fits the edits perfectly. Plus, if you need a B-roll clip in between, you can have Claude generate it, and then just drop it straight into the timeline. Want the whole setup for yourselves? Just comment "video" down below, and I'll send you the link directly.
